$comment: German (and Luther, which sword2bible aliases to it) -> KJV-English verse map.
DERIVATION: libsword 1.9's German and Luther systems are identical to each other, and in
the Old Testament identical to MT in every chapter except 2 Kgs 15 (39 verses; MT and KJV
38) and Neh 7 (73 verses like KJV; MT 72). German Bibles number the OT like the Hebrew
Bible, psalm superscriptions included. So this map EXTENDS the MT map and adds only what
differs; its own rules come first, and the first matching rule wins.
- Neh 7: German numbers it like KJV, so the MT rule moving 7:72 to KJV 7:73 must not apply.
- 2 Cor 13: German 13:12 is KJV 13:12-13, so German 13:13 is KJV 13:14.
- Acts 19: German 19:40 covers KJV 19:40-41; KJV 19:41 stays a hole.
- Rev 12:18 and 3 John 15 are handled by sword2bible's variant-verse table.
- 2 Kgs 15:39 has no rule: the converter folds it onto 15:38.
Check any German or Luther conversion with tools/import/sword/verify/swordcheck.py.
